name: @privacy-wallet/api
description: The API (doc §44–§46, §63–§64, §67–§68; spec v2.0 §15): Express 5 over the swap engine and node:sqlite (WAL). Quotes, and records for swaps and cross-chain swaps only — never a note, a key, a phrase, a witness, a balance, the user's address, an IP, a user agent or the funding transaction; the order's destination and refund material only until finalize. Opaque op_/qt_ ids, no listing, retention purged every 10 minutes, privacy-safe logs.
